summary: Iter65 (payment exclude + roster bulk-delete + schedule scope + keyboard fix): 4/4 backend tests PASS via /app/backend/tests/test_iter65_features.py. Frontend flows verified end-to-end: (a) Payment tracker 'Not required to pay' Switch (testID payment-member-exclude) toggles member to 'Exempt' — summary went from '0/3 paid · 3 people owe · $150.00 outstanding' to '0/2 paid · 2 people owe · $100.00 outstanding', and the row shows an 'Exempt' tag. (b) 'Edit tracker' pencil modal opens with Save button fully visible (top=775, bottom=820, viewport=844); same for 'New tracker' Create button — KeyboardAvoidingView fix confirmed. (c) Roster Select mode: tapping 'Select' shows per-row checkboxes (roster-check-<id>), tapping rows selects them, bottom bar shows '2 selected' + Delete (roster-bulk-delete). Backend bulk-delete endpoint verified via pytest (deletes 2/3, third preserved). (d) Schedule scope: PATCH /schedule/{id}?scope=future correctly leaves earlier occurrences at 10:00 AM and updates this+future to 2:00 PM (verified via pytest). All TEST_ data cleaned up; applereview team_access still true. NOTE: React Native's Alert.alert() confirmation dialog does not fire on Expo web preview (window.confirm not invoked by RN Web polyfill) — this affected UI walk-through of the destructive 'Delete' confirmation for both roster bulk-delete and schedule delete-scope sheet. Backend flow is verified; this is a known RN Web limitation, not a real-device bug. Deprecated packages: none detected. SafeAreaView: fine.
action_items: No fixes needed — features are working as designed on native mobile.

(Optional) Consider adding a web-friendly custom confirmation modal instead of Alert.alert() for destructive actions so QA/E2E on web preview can exercise them; today RN Web's Alert.alert does not surface the 'Delete' button on web (Cancel is auto-selected). Backend is protected regardless.
critical_code_review_comments: team/payment.tsx toggleExclude issues a full PUT but does not close the sheet on success — desired UX since user may want to keep editing. Fine.
roster.tsx bulkDelete uses api.post('/roster/bulk-delete', {ids}). Backend response returns {deleted: N}; frontend just reloads — good.
schedule/new.tsx scope modal cleanly reuses runScope() for both save/delete flows via scopeAction state — clean pattern.
The scope=future PATCH updates all events with same series_id whose date >= existing.date; verified via test that earlier events keep old start_time.
